official: 多摩市家庭的保育事業等の設備及び運営の基準に関する条例等の一部を改正する条例の制定について

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会会議結果

name: 保育施設の性暴力対策と職員配置を変更
summary: 家庭的保育事業などの職員配置や運営の基準が、条例で定められています。この議案では、児童対象性暴力等を防ぐための確認などを事業者に求めるほか、保育士の数に算入できる職種や配置基準の経過措置を改めます。
changes: 児童対象業務に従事する職員について、犯罪事実確認などの措置を事業者に求める
特定理学療法士等を1人まで保育士の数に算入できるようにし、保育士の支援体制を求める
満3歳以上4歳未満の児童に関する職員配置基準の経過措置を2028年3月31日までとする
満4歳以上の児童について、配置状況により保育に支障のおそれがある場合は、従来の職員配置基準を当分の間適用できるようにする
who: 家庭的保育事業などを利用する乳幼児と保護者
家庭的保育事業者など

en.name: Changes sexual violence prevention measures and staffing at childcare facilities
en.official: Regarding the Enactment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Tama City Ordinance on Standards for Equipment and Operation of Home-Based Childcare Services, etc.
en.summary: Standards for staffing and operations at home-based childcare services and similar services are set by ordinance. This bill requires providers to take measures such as checks to prevent sexual violence against children, etc. It also revises which job categories may be counted as nursery teachers and the transitional measures for staffing standards.
changes: Requires providers to take measures, including criminal-record checks, for staff engaged in work involving children
Allows up to one specified physical therapist, etc., to be counted in the number of nursery teachers, and requires a support system for nursery teachers
Sets March 31, 2028, as the end date for the transitional measure on staffing standards for children aged 3 to under 4
Allows the previous staffing standard to apply for the time being to children aged 4 and over when staffing conditions could interfere with childcare
who: Infants and young children and their guardians who use home-based childcare services, etc.
Providers of home-based childcare services, etc.
